description: Fix a java.util.PriorityQueue that compares by priority alone (no FIFO guarantee for ties) into an insertion-order-stable one
prompts: StablePriorityQueue.kt wraps java.util.PriorityQueue with a comparator that only compares Item.priority - PriorityQueue makes NO ordering guarantee among equal elements (it's a binary heap, not a stable structure). Fix it so that: (1) items with a lower priority number come out first, and (2) items with EQUAL priority always come out in the order they were originally pushed (FIFO) - add an explicit monotonically increasing insertion-order field to Item and use it as the comparator's tiebreaker.
name: add_kotlin_stable_priority_queue
